verdict.rationale: Teller documents a dedicated sandbox environment that uses simulated data and never connects to real financial institutions, so testing does not touch production data. It also has a sandbox guide with scripted test flows, such as an OTP MFA flow with the fixed code `0000`. Missing for 10: documentation on which API features (payments, webhooks, identity) behave fully in sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
